title: Give a held removal beside an unexported local task that names it a working task-sync exit instead of a release-and-import loop
outcome: Give a held removal beside an unexported local task that names it a working task-sync exit instead of a release-and-import loop
acceptance: When another host removed a task this host holds, and an unexported local task names it (a child or prerequisite), the export refusal and the import's held-task detail name an exit that succeeds: for example, apply the held removal or drop the reference here, then export; following the printed guidance no longer cycles between import and export
A CLI test drives a held pending removal through the printed set-aside: import, export, commit, revert, release and import, and checks that the removal lands and both hosts converge
